huggingface_text-clustering/run_pipeline.run_text_clustering_pipeline: run a text clustering pipeline on a HuggingFace dataset using DBSCAN and save cluster results
huggingface_text-clustering/run_pipeline.build_hf_data_clusters: build a HuggingFace dataset containing cluster summaries and examples from a ClusterClassifier object
huggingface_text-clustering/run_pipeline.build_hf_data_files: build a HuggingFace dataset with file projections, labels, and content from a ClusterClassifier
huggingface_text-clustering/run_pipeline.infer_cluster_labels: run inference on new texts using a loaded clustering pipeline and push results to HuggingFace Hub
huggingface_text-clustering/run_pipeline.extract_res: extract category and educational score from a cluster summary string

huggingface_text-clustering/src/plot_uti.plot_educational_score_distribution: plot the distribution of educational scores from a HuggingFace dataset as a histogram
huggingface_text-clustering/src/plot_uti.plot_category_sample_distribution: plot a bar chart showing the number of samples across categories in a dataset
huggingface_text-clustering/src/plot_uti.extract_category_and_score: extract the category and educational score from a dataset example's summary field
huggingface_text-clustering/src/plot_uti.get_dataset_size: get the total number of examples across all entries in a dataset
huggingface_text-clustering/src/plot_uti.generate_category_count_csv: generate a CSV file with category names and their corresponding sample counts

huggingface_text-clustering/src/text_clu.init_cluster_classifier: create a ClusterClassifier with sentence transformer embeddings, UMAP projection, and DBSCAN clustering parameters
huggingface_text-clustering/src/text_clu.fit_cluster_classifier: fit a ClusterClassifier on a list of texts to compute embeddings, clusters, and LLM summaries
huggingface_text-clustering/src/text_clu.infer_cluster_labels: infer cluster labels for new texts using a fitted ClusterClassifier and FAISS nearest neighbor search
huggingface_text-clustering/src/text_clu.save_cluster_classifier: save a fitted ClusterClassifier model including embeddings, projections, cluster labels, and summaries to a folder
huggingface_text-clustering/src/text_clu.load_cluster_classifier: load a previously saved ClusterClassifier model from a folder including embeddings, projections, and cluster labels
